description: AI lanes: each runs `claude -p` once in its own worktree and branch (lane/<name>), commits there and stops; the main session reads the result and merges. scripts/lane.py starts them; make kickoff starts `kickoff` right after the early import (KICKOFF_LANES overrides it, empty disables). Permission mode dontAsk denies every tool outside allowed_tools without asking: no web access, no remote command, no push (curl is allowed, and tool-guard limits it to localhost in a lane). tool-guard (ISUCON_LANE) also refuses remote nodes, deploy, benchmarks and the operation lock.

code-map.purpose: 回収したコードからdocs/code-map.mdを書く

indexes.purpose: 索引不足だけを1索引1commitで先行実装する（baselineまでdeployしない）

obvious-fixes.purpose: 索引以外の自明なボトルネックを1件1commitで先行実装する（baselineまでdeployしない）

local-env.purpose: ローカル実行環境を構成してmake local-checkを通し、docs/local-verification.mdを書く

scenario.purpose: 公式資料とコードからdocs/benchmark-scenario.mdを書く（mainがdocs/officialをcommitしてから起動）
